scope: Preserve the documented DIMASSOC osnap XREF handle strings in DXF without treating them as host-drawing handles, and record the focused verification boundary.

evidence.interpretation: Groups 301 and 302 are retained as opaque DXF strings. The implementation does not parse their grammar, validate cross-database resolution, or remap them in the host drawing handle graph.
evidence.dwgBoundary: DXF XREF strings do not establish a DWG field layout; the DWG encoder refuses this DXF-only metadata before output.

behaviors: Preserve group 301 and group 302 text in DXF parse/write paths.
Refuse duplicate or orphaned fields as unrepresentable typed details.
Keep XREF strings outside local host-handle resolution/remapping and emitted-entity closure.
Refuse DWG encoding when XREF string details are present or nonempty.

strictBuild.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_hardening_tests libdxfrw_wave1_tests lc3_compat_check dwg2dxf -j2
